name: rebuild-charge-spooled
why: the reference engine has one path for holding the output of a rebuild (in memory) and no switch that spools it or streams it to a caller, so there are not two engines to compare; the engine's charge depends on total_length alone (blobs.collect) and a second read of the same input gives an equal result, which rebuild-charge-repeated and the equal results of rebuild-charge-witness show without a switch (P4-39, P4-59)
